title: Transition metal-catalyzed cross-coupling reactions of N-aryl-2-aminopyridines
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1134-1151
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08384A, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Fatemeh Doraghi, Lina Rezainia, Mohammad Hossein Morshedsolouk, Hamed Navid, Bagher Larijani, Mohammad Mahdavi
Owing to the pyridyl directing group, N-aryl-2-amnopyridines form stable metal complexes towards N-heterocycles and nitrogen-based compounds. We reviewed transition metal-catalyzed annulation and functionalization reactions of this synthon.
